purpose: Validate YAML files without launching a device or browser
agent_use: Run before every device/browser/desktop/HC execution
notes: Treat valid:false as an authoring bug

purpose: List discovered test files and command indexes
agent_use: Use before rerunning a failed command index
notes: Do not count indexes manually

purpose: Print bundled Lumi YAML JSON Schema
agent_use: Use when command shape or selector fields are unclear
notes: Guardrail only; schema is permissive, so confirm exact fields in command references

purpose: Compute SRS requirement coverage from requirements/index.yaml against cases.csv - never trust a hand-written status field
agent_use: Run before reporting a testcase suite as done when a requirements/ directory exists
notes: Nonzero exit if any non-skipped requirement lacks an on-disk testcase or is missing a policy-required tag; see testcase-design.md 'SRS Requirements Format'

purpose: Check local platform dependencies
agent_use: Use before first run and when runtime dependencies fail
notes: Run separately for android android_auto ios web macos and windows when doing platform coverage checks

purpose: List connected devices for a platform
agent_use: Use before choosing a target mobile Android Auto or local desktop target
notes: For desktop this reports the local host target

purpose: Run test file or directory
agent_use: Run full flows and minimal failing command reruns
notes: For lumi_hc set LUMI_HC_URL/LUMI_HC_WS_URL and use hcHealth as readiness

purpose: Generate report from test results
agent_use: Use when reports need to be regenerated from saved results
notes: Usually run already creates reports with --report

purpose: Start web inspector for visual test creation
agent_use: Use for unfamiliar UI and selector discovery
notes: Long-running server; stop it after use

purpose: Record user interactions and generate YAML
agent_use: Use when user wants to capture a manual Android flow
notes: Review generated selectors before committing

purpose: Install AI agent integrations and skill files
agent_use: Use after package install so Codex can discover the skill
notes: One-line AI installers call this automatically

purpose: Open interactive Lumi shell, or run one-off command(s) directly with -c/--command (no YAML file needed)
agent_use: Prefer -c/--command over writing+running a throwaway YAML file for a quick one-off action (tap/type/screenshot/pinch/etc) - each -c uses the same YAML-sugar syntax as a test file command and all -c values in one call share a single device session. Plain shell (no -c) is an interactive human prompt, not for agent use.
notes: Exits non-zero if any -c command failed, so a caller can check the exit code alone; --json prints one {"command","success","error"} object per line. Interactive mode: current CLI shell does not support web or android_auto - prefer validate/list/run for those.

purpose: Manage local system components and drivers
agent_use: Use when setting up missing dependencies after doctor identifies gaps
notes: May install tools; prefer doctor first

purpose: Run camera-based hardware verification workflows
agent_use: Use for camera visual verification of physical hardware LEDs
notes: Run camera hardware testing workflows

purpose: Detect serial ports and test Jig connection
agent_use: Use to verify serial/Jig connection before running hardware tests
notes: Lists available COM ports and pings Jig hardware with optional node ID

purpose: Check or perform self-update to latest release from GitHub
agent_use: Update Lumi Tester CLI and VS Code Extension in-place
notes: Supports --check for version checking and in-place upgrade on macOS/Windows/Linux

purpose: Print installed and latest release versions
agent_use: Check latest CLI and Extension releases on GitHub
notes: Queries GitHub Releases and reports update availability

purpose: Suggest ranked, cross-platform-correct selectors for elements matching a query and/or near a point
agent_use: Use instead of manually reading a large hierarchy dump when no Inspector is running
notes: --file reads a saved hierarchy dump (e.g. a failure artifact) instead of a live device; same scoring engine as /api/suggest-selectors and the suggest_selectors MCP tool

purpose: Open the Lumi Tester documentation website in the default browser
agent_use: Use to point a user at the hosted docs instead of guessing a URL
notes: --print prints the URL instead of opening a browser; safe for headless/CI use

purpose: Show the running binary path, PATH-resolved binary, and AI skill/config directories
agent_use: Diagnose an IDE/MCP client using a stale lumi-tester binary
notes: Alias: where. Flags pathMismatch when PATH resolves to a different binary than the one currently running
